question: A cone-shaped temple top has slant height of 11 m and radius of base is 10 m. Find the total cost for painting its curved surface area at the rate of Rs. 7/m². [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
**Given:**

Slant height is 11 m,

Radius of base is 10 m,

Rate of painting is Rs. 7 per m².

**Formula used:**

Total curved surface area = πrL

**Calculations:**

Total curved surface of Temple,

⇒ π.r.L

⇒ (22)/(7) × 11 × 10

⇒ 110π m²

Cost of painting,

⇒ 110π × 7 = 770 × (22)/(7) 

⇒ Rs. 2420

**∴ Cost of painting the curved surface area of Temple is Rs. 2,420.**
